name: tiktok-monitor
description: Portable TikTok monitoring plugin that locks the repository's stable CloakBrowser collection wrapper and append-only Base sync path.

interface.shortDescription: Run the locked stable TikTok collection wrapper
interface.longDescription: TikTok monitor is the formal execution wrapper for the repository's stable whitelist collection flow: single-plan CloakBrowser batches, rollover guardrails, and append-only Feishu Base sync.
defaultPrompt: Use TikTok monitor cycle to run the approved stable whitelist collection flow. Use cycle --background for Codex automations or other time-limited shells.
Use TikTok monitor status to inspect the current collection plan and cursor.
Use TikTok monitor sync to run the approved append-only Base sync only.
